description: This file provides an EncryptionService struct for handling encryption and decryption of configuration data. It includes methods to create the service with a derived key, encrypt/decrypt strings, and process configuration maps to handle sensitive fields securely.

classes.name: EncryptionService
classes.description: Provides encryption and decryption functionalities for sensitive configuration values using AES-GCM with a key derived from a passphrase.

methods.name: NewEncryptionService
methods.description: Constructs a new EncryptionService by deriving a 32-byte key from the provided passphrase using SHA-256.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext string using AES-GCM and returns a base64-encoded ciphertext.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a base64-encoded ciphertext string back to plaintext.

methods.name: EncryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Encrypts specified secret fields within a configuration map.

methods.name: DecryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Decrypts specified secret fields within a configuration map.
